Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this extremely one-sided match. On 13th September (Tuesday), these two teams will cross swords in the second T20I at 11 pm IST (5.30 pm GMT). As always, you can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Sarah Glenn (4-0-23-4) is the Player of the Match. Says that they did well as a unit and thanks the crowd as well for all the support. Shares that it was tough to grip the ball, so bowling a disciplined line was crucial. On her bowling partnership with Sophie Ecclestone, Glenn replies that Sophie is a crucial player for the team and she looks up to her and feels they bowl well together. Tells that she knew if the batters play their game, they will be fine in the chase.

Amy Jones, the captain of England Women, is all smiles. Says that winning the first game of the series is always important. Shares that she is quiet as a captain and praises the girls for stepping up. Mentions that she kept getting inputs from many players and she takes all the information and tries to read the game. Feels that it was a good score to chase as the pitch was a bit skiddy. States that it's fantastic to win so convincingly and calls the form of their top three unbelievable.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women, is looking very upset. Says that they were forced to play as the conditions were not apt. She is happy that her girls put in the effort. Further says that the ground was too wet and there were chances to get injured. Also says that one of her key bowlers got injured and that affected them. Adds that they are here to play cricket and the next two games are important and they will look to bounce back.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier, England Women were superb with the ball. They started in an ordinary way but quickly pulled things back. Sarah Glenn's four-fer pushed India Women on the back foot and the touring team never recovered. Deepti Sharma scored some handy runs at the backend but eventually, a total of 132 was demolished by England Women.

This is a game India Women would like to forget quickly. They were below-par with the bat, insipid with the ball and abject with their ground fielding. They dropped a few catches and were shambolic on the field. Renuka Singh had Sophia Dunkley caught in the first over but she had overstepped and from thereon, Dunkley made India pay. Shafali Verma dropped a sitter of a catch offered by her and all in all, nothing went India's way this evening. Harmanpreet Kaur will be very disappointed with the overall effort of her girls.

A thumping win for England Women! They overhauled the target with 7 overs to spare and handed India Women a hefty defeat. It's a clinical performance from the home team, both with the ball and with the bat. Sophia Dunkley was brilliant and made use of the lives granted to her while Alice Capsey once again stamped her class.
FOUR! ENGLAND WOMEN WIN BY 9 WICKETS! Renuka Singh delivers a full toss around middle and leg, Sophia Dunkley goes down on one knee and sweeps it exceedingly well behind square leg for a boundary.

Appeal for a run out! Very full and around off, Sophia bunts it down to long off and they hustle across for the second run. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end and it's referred upstairs. The replays find Alice Capsey easily in.
Slower through the air, full again and outside off, Alice Capsey strokes it down to long off for another run.
Fullish and on off, forced down to long off for a run.
Full toss, close to off, Alice smashes it aerially back and the bowler pulls her hand back. It goes to long off and they cross.
A low dipping full toss on off, it's driven to deep cover-point for a single.
Renuka Singh is back on. 0 for 13 in her 3 overs so far.
Fuller in length and outside off, Alice plays a gorgeous off drive and it races away. The long off fielder makes the stop to her left and they get two. 9 needed more.
Full and around off, Sophia bends her back knee and slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker on off, dug out to covers.
Wide! Too full and too wide outside off, Sophia attempts to drive but misses.
Up and over! Full and wide outside off, Dunkley reaches out and lofts it over extra cover for two.
Eases a full ball to long off for a single.
FOUR! The bowler feeds a juicy full toss outside off, Capsey needs no second invitation as she crunches it through extra cover for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Quicker and outside off, skidding off the surface, Sophia Dunkley reaches out and tries to cut but misses.
Too full and on middle, Capsey knocks it to long on for a single.
Short delivery again, outside off, this time it's hit to point. A rare dot.
Width there outside off, short in length, Dunkley forces it off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run. Fifty for Sophia Dunkley, her second in T20Is.

FOUR! The 50-run stand comes up, off 26 balls. England Women are marching. Full and floated, around off, Sophia Dunkley skips down the track and clubs it down to long off for a boundary. 22 needed off 58 balls.
FOUR! Add another misfield to the list. Full and floated, around off, Dunkley sweeps it sweetly behind square leg where the fielder dives in the deep but lets it through.
Short and wide outside off, Alice tries to cut but misses.
SIX! Flatter this time, short and on off, Alice Capsey uses her feet and dispatches it over long off for a maximum. 100 up!
Wide! A leg spinner is attempted by Kaur, way wide outside off, Capsey flashes and misses. Free Hit stays...
High full toss, on middle, Sophia pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Called a no ball. Free Hit coming.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This has been a sad story of the Indian fielding. Short and way wide outside off, Sophia Dunkley rocks back and slaps it to deep point where Simran Bahadur (sub) misfields and concedes a boundary.

Flatter and shorter, outside off, Dunkley camps back and whacks it through extra cover. Two fielders converge near the fence, nearly make a mess as there is no communication but somehow keep it inside the boundary line. Two taken.
Flighted delivery, landing full and wide outside off, Sophia mistimes her drive back to the bowler.
Loopy one, full and around off, Sophia dinks it down to short fine leg for a run.
Change. Harmanpreet Kaur is ready to bowl.
Fuller and around off, it's fired in, Alice drives it straight back and the bowler makes a partial stop.

SIX! Dismissed! Capsey is showing why she is the next big thing in English cricket! Floated and full outside off, Alice Capsey strides forward and thumps it straight down the ground for a maximum. Confident and calm! 47 needed off 67 balls.
Jumps down the track and eases a full ball to long on, once more. Another run.
Another full ball has been knocked down to long on for a single.
Full and on middle, forced down to long on for a run.

SIX! Just escapes the fielder. Flighted ball around off, Sophia Dunkley lofts it straight down the ground. Harmanpreet Kaur is standing quite straight at long on and rushes across to her left. She stretches her hands out but it escapes the attempt and flies over the fence. The replays show that it burst off the hands.
Goes very full and on middle, Alice pushes it down to mid on.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short in length and around off, Alice Capsey stays back to ride the bounce and pulls it emphatically in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Back of a length and outside off, Alice Capsey goes back and throws her bat at it but fails to connect.

FOUR! Boom! Pooja delivers it around off, on a length, Alice steps back and slaps it straight back aerially. Pooja Vastrakar ducks to take evasive action and it hurries behind. The fielder from mid on chases but is lazy while pulling it back and it rolls over the fence.
Full and around leg, it's worked off the pads to short mid-wicket.
Aerial but safe! Short in length and outside off, Dunkley punches it aerially from the toe end of her bat. It falls short of mid off and they cross.
Pooja Vastrakar is into the attack now.
Gets back and plays it down to cover-point for a quick run.
Goes on the back foot and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Floated and full, around off, driven to covers.
Flatter and shorter, around off, the batter cuts but finds the point fielder.

OUT! STUMPED! Rana senses the charge from the batter and fires it down the leg side. Wyatt shimmies down and tries to flick but misses. The keeper collects the ball away from the stumps and has to stretch out to take the bails off. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. The third umpire checks for the edge first which is absent. The side-on angle then shows that Wyatt is well short of the crease. India Women have a breakthrough. A wicket off a wide. 73 needed off 82 balls. Alice Capsey is in next.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: Appeal for a stumping...
Wyatt also uses her feet and knocks a full ball down to wide long on for a couple of runs.
Flighted and outside off, Dunkley advances down the track and drives it aerially but quickly past the bowler to long off. They cross.
Sneh Rana is into the attack now. A slip is present.

FOUR! Bang! Deepti drags her length short and delivers it on off, this time Wyatt rocks back and pulls it powerfully to the deep mid-wicket fence. Powerplay done. England Women are 56 for 0. 77 needed more off 84 balls.
FOUR! Fine shot! Floated one, full and outside off, Danni Wyatt gets across the crease, goes down and powers it over mid on for a boundary. 50 up!
Wide! Way wide outside off, Danni shuffles across and leaves.
A half-tracker outside off, Wyatt cuts it through point for a couple.

Run out chance! Loopy and full, around off, Dunkley walks forward and drives it towards mid off. She sets off for a run but her partner is ball-watching. Danni Wyatt takes off late but the throw is a wild one allowing her to complete the single easily.
Advances down the track to take it on the full but drives it straight to extra cover.
Short and wide outside off, cut to covers for a single.
Slower through the air, full and wide outside off, a real tempter, Dunkley tries to reach out and drive but mistimes it towards extra cover.
A fantastic yorker, right in the blockhole, Dunkley has her bat down in time to dig it out safely.
Angles in a full ball on off, it's driven through covers for a single.
Fuller and on middle, flicked firmly to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Finds the fence this time! Renuka Singh delivers it on a length and outside off, Sophia Dunkley drives it aerially over cover-point and finds the fence again.
PUT DOWN! India's fielding has been nothing short of disappointing. Fuller and around off, Sophia Dunkley mistimes her lofted shot to mid off where Shafali Verma puts down a sitter.
A near yorker on middle, Sophia digs it out down to long on for one. 12 from the over, this end continues to leak runs.
FOUR! Well played! Sharma tosses it up and lands it full and outside off, Sophia Dunkley again uses her feet and this time lofts it over mid off for a boundary.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Loopy delivery, full and on middle, Sophia Dunkley dances down the track and whips it to deep mid-wicket. Pooja Vastrakar makes a complete mess as it spins away from her late and goes to the fence.
Edgy! Full and floated on off, Sophia walks forward and tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It evades the cover fielder inside the ring and they collect a brace.
Short in length and wide outside off, Wyatt gets across and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Flighted and full, landing outside off and turning in, Wyatt has her bat down at the last moment to keep it out on the off side.
Deepti Sharma comes into the attack.
Full in length and outside off, Dunkley toe-ends her drive towards wide mid off. No run to end the over.

FOUR BYES! More extras for England Women. A touch short in length, around middle and leg, Sophia steps back to heave it over the leg side but misses. The keeper fails to collect and it scoots behind for a boundary.
Another slower one, a length ball on off, Danni dabs it down to backward point and steals a quick run.
Slower one this time, full and on middle, Danni defends it back to the bowler.
Follows the batter down the leg side with an inswinger. Dunkley tries to pull but misses. It goes off her thigh pad to short fine leg and they cross for a leg bye.
Movement off the surface. A length ball, curling in from around off, Dunkley keeps it out from the inner half of her bat.

The physio comes out. Radha Yadav has not moved after that fall. Looks like a shoulder injury. She is holding her right shoulder and heading off the field. Let's hope there is no serious damage done. Simran Bahadur is the substitute.

Lands it on a length around off, Wyatt taps it down to backward point where Radha Yadav dives but misfields. It deflects away from her and they cross. The fielder stays down and the batters steal another run.
Short in length and wide outside off, Danni offers no shot in the hope to get a wide. It is not.
Brings a full ball in from around off, Wyatt defends it close to her front pad.
FOUR! That's a cracking shot! Full and outside off, Danni Wyatt latches onto it and blazes it through extra cover for a boundary.
Back of a length around off, Danni steers it past backward point for a brace.
Around off, on a length and angling in, Wyatt defends it from the back foot.
FIVE WIDES! Wrong line. Down the leg side, further shaping down, the batter tries to flick but misses and Richa Ghosh has no chance of stopping it. A boundary at fine leg.
Pooja Vastrakar is ready to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Smashed! A length ball again, around middle, Sophia Dunkley steps back to make room and smacks it over the bowler's head for a boundary. That nearly took the umpire's head off.
Wide! Sprays it down the leg side, it's a good take by the Indian keeper.
Edged but safe!  A length is angled in around off, Sophia Dunkley sticks back to push inside the line but edges it towards first slip. The ball though dies down in front of the keeper.
Full and outside off, Sophia Dunkley tries to drive but misses.
Swing and a miss! A length delivery wide outside off, staying low, Dunkley throws her bat at it but misses.

OUT! BUT IT'S A NO BALL! Renuka has overstepped. Almost a perfect start for India Women. A cutter outside off, Dunkley pushes inside the line and edges it behind. It's a good reflex catch from the keeper, who came up to the stumps after the last ball. The finger has gone up. The umpire then checks for the front foot and the replays show that Renuka Singh has overstepped by a small margin. Free Hit coming...
This one moves back into the batter from a length around off, Sophia Dunkley walks forward and tries to middle her shot but fails to get the connection.
Renuka Singh begins with a length ball outside off, Sophia Dunkley allows it through to the keeper.
